title: Baseline and harness
hyp: Freeze the evaluator; measure the incumbent.
change: bench/perf: scene generator (composite + stress + scaling), run.mjs (orbit timing, cost counters, stills), compare.py (image gates)
result: Composite settled 5.67 s/frame (σ≈1.5%, 5 runs), moving 1.53 s; 11.8 field evaluations per covered pixel, 9.2 objects per evaluation.

title: Attribution (switch-off experiments, earlier build)
hyp: Find what dominates before changing anything.
change: variants without sweeps / normals / AO
result: Sweeps ≈ half the frame; normals ≈ 25%; AO ≈ 30%; per-object loops make 4 pieces 2.5× slower per pixel even off screen.

title: Bake the field into a 3D texture once per edit (H3) + start the exact pass from it (H4)
hyp: The field is static between edits: pay it once, not per pixel per frame.
change: bake.ts: FRAG with SDF_BAKE fills a half-float 3D texture (192 along the longest side) in GPU-paced batches; moving frames march it; settled rays start at the baked hit; misses stop at once; occlusion from the texture.
result: Settled 5.67 → 3.58 s (1.58×), moving 1.53 s → 43 ms (35×, now full resolution). Images: 0.07% diff, 16 missed px, IoU 0.9995. Bake ≈ 9.7 s headless per edit.

title: Attribution of the settled pass on the baked build
hyp: Where does the remaining 3.6 s go?
change: variants: skip everything after the start depth / no ray masks / no normals
result: Fixed cost 0.19 s; normals 1.3 s (4 exact evaluations); the rest is the exact march (~6 evaluations). Ray masks help (removing them: 8 s). Cost ∝ exact evaluations at hit pixels.

title: Per-cell object masks for the settled pass (H2-lite)
hyp: Near the surface only nearby objects matter: a 16³ grid of 128-bit masks cuts objects per evaluation.
change: masks in the data texture, map() wraps the program with the cell's mask, capped at U
result: Slower: 7.47 s (objects/eval 11.3 → 8.9 only; boxes grown by blend + openings cover most cells; the wrapper slowed the shader). A first build failed to link (the program inlined 9×).

title: Three-sample normals at the hit (H8)
hyp: Forward differences reuse the field at the hit: 3 evaluations instead of 4.
change: calcNormal(p, e, d0)

title: Newton refinement from the baked hit
hyp: Step by d / cos(angle to the baked surface): fewer exact steps.
change: 6 Newton steps both ways, capped at 1.5 voxels
result: Evaluations/px 8.7 → 5.9 but slower (3.96 s) and 55 missed px. The software renderer punishes the extra code shape; proxy caveat noted.

title: Quality probe: the baked image alone
hyp: How close is the cheap baked image to the exact one?
change: settled = baked march
result: 40 ms (140× faster) but fails gates: 3% diff, IoU 0.9885 — a 1 px silhouette fringe and faint stripes from trilinear normals. Exact normals and silhouettes are what the exact pass is for.

title: Start the exact march at the baked hit (no back-off)
hyp: Ahead of the true surface it marches on (silhouettes exact); behind it, the hit is within a quarter voxel.
change: uStartBack = 0
result: 3.23 → 3.12 s; images unchanged.

title: Object masks for the stretch of ray round the baked hit (no fallback)
hyp: Every exact evaluation is within a few voxels of the baked hit: mask only objects near that stretch.
change: rayMask over [ts−2h, ts+3h], march ends there
result: 1.33 s (4.3×) but 424 missed px: rays grazing an edge the bake rounded over must go on to what's behind.

title: Windowed masks with a fallback to the rest of the ray
hyp: Same, but a ray leaving the window without a hit widens its mask and carries on (same loop, no extra inlining).
change: rayMask re-run past the window
result: 3.12 → 1.52 s (3.74×); objects/eval 11.3 → 6.2; images unchanged (16 missed, IoU 0.9995).

title: Refine the baked start depth (two steps on the baked field)
hyp: The start pass stopped at a quarter voxel; two more steps put the exact march closer.
change: start pass refines; back-off 0 / 0.1 / 0.25 voxel tried: 1.25 s (34 missed) / 1.37 s (29) / 1.41 s (23)

title: Snap to the surface at the first close exact evaluation
hyp: Accept the first exact eval with |d|<0.3h and project along the ray: saves most march steps
change: Projection p - n·d after one exact eval
result: 1002 ms but extra 369 px, IoU 0.9886: rays near silhouettes snap onto surfaces they would miss. Retry with snap only for d<=0 or |d|<0.05h.

title: Narrow-band bake
hyp: Bake only voxels near the surface, from a cheap lower bound
change: Per-voxel lower bound from object boxes, grown for openings and cuts
result: Bake 10.8 s, unchanged: growth for openings and cuts covers almost the whole box. Retry with bounds from add objects only (cuts and hollowing only raise the field).

title: Merge the exact-field lineage into the bake lineage
hyp: The exact-field agent's cheaper map() (one call site, leaner interpreter, ~2x alone) multiplies with the baked start
change: Merge claude/sdf-perf-exact; the single call-site loop now carries the windowed fallback, 3-tap normals and baked AO
result: Composite 1374 -> 680 ms (8.3x baseline); sweeps-64 1312 ms; image unchanged (diff 0.34%, IoU 0.9991)

title: Full suite on the merged build: image gates on every scene
hyp: The strict floor must hold on all scenes, not just composite
change: Image check of all 14 scenes against the baseline
result: Composite, sweeps, blend, shell, csg, close-up, pieces-1 pass. custom-section 1.86%, grazing 3.48%, pieces-9 0.97%, pieces-4 0.53% fail strict. The merge is pixel-identical to the bake lineage: the failures came from earlier kept steps gated on composite only. Diff maps: creases (3-sample forward normals see one side of a sharp edge) and thin-slab rims (baked start past a thin wall).

title: Snap v2: snap only where the ray faces the surface
hyp: Accept the first exact evaluation within 0.3 voxel and step along the ray onto the surface when -n·rd > 0.3; grazing rays keep marching
change: One snap attempt per ray in the single-call-site loop
result: Composite 671 -> 629 ms (-6%) but diff 0.49% (limit 0.5%), grazing extra 67 px, IoU 0.998. The refined start leaves only ~2-3 march steps, so there is little to save; not worth the image risk.

title: Clean full-suite rerun under the CPU lock
hyp: Runs timed while agents build are unreliable
change: Same merged build, full suite, now with the CPU mutex and contamination check
result: pieces-9 1056 ms (unlocked, agents building) vs 662 ms clean: a 60% error from parallel builds. Other scenes within noise. Clean run is the incumbent reference.

title: Tetrahedral 4-tap normals (gate repair candidate)
hyp: The 3-sample forward normals misshade creases
change: 4 tetrahedral taps instead of 3 forward differences
result: Diff: composite 0.34->0.19%, grazing 3.48->2.08%, pieces-9 0.97->0.67%, custom-section 1.86->1.90% (its failure is coverage: 131 missed px, IoU 0.9963). Cost +10%. Bisecting the saved builds to find where each failure entered.

title: First iPhone run (user, Clay Preview, merged build)
hyp: The headless proxy's ratios carry to the phone
change: View -> Run the benchmark scene on the user's iPhone (DPR 3, ratio 2, 804x544)
result: Composite on iPhone: settled 18 ms (vs 691 headless), orbit 1-2 ms, bake 109 ms. The phone is ~38x faster than the proxy on the settled frame. The 4-jug piece still lost the GPU context 0.4-0.9 s after its field changed at rest (4 hollow bodies), on the build before the row-strip bake; fixed further by skipping the whole exact frame while the bake is pending (7239f50). Awaiting a rerun.

title: Strict-gate repair: tetrahedral normals + 0.5-voxel back-off (regime: still)
hyp: Bisect: 3-sample normals broke creases; starting at the refined baked hit missed inner-silhouette pixels
change: 4 tetrahedral normal taps; start the exact window 0.5 voxel before the baked hit
result: Strict now on composite 0.07%, csg 0.08%, custom-section 0.41%, pieces-4 0.08%, pieces-9 0.17%; grazing 2.0% (thin slabs, since bake v1). Still frame composite 652 -> 810 ms. Orbit unaffected; editing unaffected (exact path only used with a bake).

title: Bricks lineage, first result (agent, regime: still; bake cost)
hyp: Fine sparse bricks near the surface let the settled frame avoid most exact evaluations
change: Coarse 192^3 bake, then (N+1)^3-sample bricks of the exact field in a band (N=4, N=8 where the coarse field bends); settled pass marches and shades from bricks
result: Settled: composite 100 ms (57x baseline), sweeps-64 108, pieces-9 81, close-up 147, grazing 235, custom-section 108. Strict on composite, sweeps-64, close-up. Bake 4-30x longer (composite 27 s headless): time to sharp after an edit is the cost. Orbit unchanged; editing unaffected.

title: Pruning lineage, first result (agent, regime: still)
hyp: Per-cell object masks (Lipschitz pruning) cut objects per evaluation
change: Cells of 2 voxels after the bake; masks ANDed into the settled ray mask once per ray
result: Bit-identical image; objects/eval 6.19 -> 5.4; 5-7% faster. Small because the composite's objects really overlap. Agent redirected to the editing regime.

title: Full suite on the repaired build (all three regimes)
hyp: Confirm the gate repair across all scenes
change: Full 14-scene suite, clean under the CPU lock
result: Diff gate passes on 13/14 (grazing 2.0%). IoU slightly short on custom-section (0.9985) and pieces-9 (0.9988): missed silhouette pixels. Still composite 858 ms (6.6x baseline); orbit 46 ms; editing 725 ms; bake 4.3 s.

title: Near-approach start depths (regime: still)
hyp: Walls thinner than a voxel stay positive in the baked texture, so the baked march steps past them
change: Start the exact window at an earlier near approach (baked d < 0.5 voxel) when it is >2 voxels before the baked hit, or when the bake finds no hit
result: Missed px: composite 16 -> 1, grazing 28 -> 4; IoU strict on every scene (custom-section 0.9992, pieces-9 0.9998). Composite 858 -> 934 ms. 0.75 voxel: same gates, slower (rejected). Orbit and editing unaffected.

title: Exact occlusion in concave corners (regime: still)
hyp: Grazing's remaining 1.7% is baked occlusion missing tight inside corners
change: Exact occlusion taps everywhere (probe) and only where the baked occlusion is dark (hybrid)
result: Grazing diff unchanged at 1.71% (PSNR 32 -> 37): refuted. Zoom: both reference and candidate show speckled dashes along an inner rim thinner than a pixel seen edge-on; only the dot positions differ. Cost +30% (exact) / +10% (hybrid); not kept.

title: Aliasing-tolerant image metric (announced harness change)
hyp: Strict diff24 counts sub-pixel aliasing shifts as differences
change: compare.py reports diff24aa (1-px tolerance) beside diff24; gates unchanged, scenes passing only the tolerant metric are labelled
result: Current build: grazing 1.71% strict -> 0.09% with 1-px tolerance; custom-section 0.30 -> 0.08%; composite 0.02 -> 0.01%. Grazing passes with a 1-px aliasing tolerance; every other scene passes strict.

title: Narrow-band bake from object bounds (regime: time to sharp after edit)
hyp: Cuts, masks, hollowing and openings only raise the field, so a lower bound from object bounds minus blend reach is safe without opening/cut growth
change: SDF_BAKE writes the lower bound where it exceeds 4 voxels, else map()
result: Bake: composite 4.27 -> 3.85 s, pieces-4 6.18 -> 4.89 s, sweeps-64 23.7 -> 26.3 s (worse). Images identical. Not worth the code; bake time moves to the bricks agent.

title: iPhone 4-jug crash: fence-paced exact moving frames, bake paused while moving (device stability)
hyp: The GPU reset while orbiting before the bake finished: exact frames (~79 ms GPU) requested at 60/s plus bake batches piled up
change: Exact moving/drag frames wait on a fence for the previous one; bake steps only while the view is still
result: Headless: orbit during a pending bake keeps the bake paused, exact frames paced, bake completes after release, no errors. Awaiting the user's iPhone rerun.

title: Editing lineage: reuse the stale bake mid-drag (agent, regime: editing)
hyp: Mid-drag, only rays crossing the changed objects' boxes need the exact field; the rest can use the bake from before the edit
change: FieldSnapshot at bake start; dirty boxes of changed objects; a shader variant (swapped in only during a drag) marches exactly only for rays through dirty boxes
result: Drag frames: composite 687 -> 272 ms, sweeps-64 1816 -> 471, blend-heavy 315 -> 163, csg 321 -> 193; still frame unchanged (bit-identical). Not yet merged.

title: Bricks lineage: cone pre-pass (agent, regime: still)
hyp: One coarse ray per 4x4 block finds where its cone nears the surface; pixel rays start there
change: Cone pre-pass before the brick march
result: Composite 51 ms (~111x baseline), pieces-9 43, custom-section 59, but 2/3 of clay missed (cones ran out of steps); agent fixing. Not yet kept.

title: Bricks lineage: full suite (agent, regime: still)
hyp: Fine bricks + curvature correction + one-atlas reads + cone pre-pass make the settled frame texture-only
change: Coarse bake, exact-sample bricks in the surface band (N=4, N=8 on sharp cells), cone pre-pass per 4x4 block
result: Settled: composite 58 ms (~98x), sweeps 75-83, pieces 53-63, blend 60, shell 67, csg 47, custom 76, grazing 227, close-up 92. Strict on 10/14; pieces-4 IoU 0.9989, pieces-9 0.66%, custom-section 0.85%, grazing 3.53% (aa 0.50%) fail. Bake 4-10x longer (composite 19 s headless). Next: exact refinement pass for flagged pixels only.

title: Merge the editing lineage (regime: editing)
hyp: Mid-drag, the stale bake holds exactly away from the changed objects' boxes
change: Snapshot at bake start; up to 8 dirty boxes per drag frame (<8 ms CPU); rays clear of them take the settled window path, the rest march exactly from the first box (SDF_DIRTY variant); translation-only edits bound where changed rays start
result: Real drags (agent script): composite tab 756 -> 411 ms, sweeps-64 rib 1826 -> 683, pieces-4 tab 798 -> 368; whole-body reshape ~unchanged. Harness msEdit (no-op edit, best case) composite 711 -> 333. Still frame and images unchanged (composite 923 ms, strict). Orbit unchanged.

title: Honest editing numbers: benchEdit moves an object (regime: editing)
hyp: The no-op edit flattered the stale-bake reuse
change: Harness change: each edit frame moves the middle object 0.05 further along x
result: Real drag frames (merged build) vs the exact frame before the merge: composite 725 -> 414 ms (1.75x), sweeps-64 1873 -> 842 (2.2x), pieces-4 788 -> 372 (2.1x), csg 318 -> 257, blend 320 -> 281. Still frame and orbit unchanged.

title: Merge the bricks lineage: settled frame from fine bricks + exact refinement of flagged pixels (regime: still)
hyp: Draw the settled frame from a fine sparse cache of the field; recompute exactly only creases and near-misses
change: Coarse bake, one level of N=4 bricks in the surface band, curvature correction, cone pre-pass, then the exact settled shader runs only for flagged pixels (a compact list, ~1-16% of pixels)
result: Still: composite 923 -> 98 ms (57.9x baseline), all scenes 73-149 ms except grazing 500. Images strict on 13/14; grazing passes the loose floor only (IoU 0.9983, aa 0.10%). Orbit unchanged; editing unchanged; bake ~2x (composite 4.3 -> 9.0 s headless).

title: Merge the refine lineage: still frame ~100x (regime: still)
hyp: Fewer and cheaper exact pixels after the brick pass
change: Narrow (32-wide) exact list for SwiftShader thread coherence; dead shader code compiled out by defines; baked per-brick normal + occlusion (one read per hit); listed rays still creeping at window end keep marching (grazing rims)
result: Composite 98 -> 57 ms (24-frame decisive run; 52-60 across runs) = 99.5x baseline. Full suite: 47-125 ms except grazing 309. IoU strict on all 14; diff strict on 13/14 (grazing 2.35%, aa 0.36%). Orbit and editing unchanged; bake slightly longer, brick memory ~2x.

title: Merge editing lineage 2: drag frames from the stale bricks image + exact list of changed pixels (regime: editing)
hyp: Mid-drag, the stale bricks image holds everywhere the moved objects can't reach; only changed pixels need the exact field, coarse to fine
change: Changed pixels found on the CPU inside the dirty boxes' screen rect; exact on a 4-px then 2-px grid then the rest, interpolating only where samples agree; occlusion from the stale bake; shader warmed when the bricks finish
result: Drag frames: composite 427 -> 117 ms (6.2x vs the 725 ms exact drag frame), sweeps-64 886 -> 188, pieces-4 388 -> 34, csg 269 -> 74, blend 287 -> 107, custom 668 -> 301. Edit-frame quality within gate (worst diff 0.36%, IoU 0.9989 vs exact). Still and orbit images identical; still composite 55 ms (103x).

title: Bake lineage: two-level coarse field + incremental re-bake (time to sharp)
hyp: Re-bake only the changed region after a local edit; map() only near the surface in the coarse bake
change: Half-resolution coarse field then band tiles; incremental coarse/brick/copy/curvature/shading over changed slots
result: Agent's six scenes: full bake -19..27%, incremental re-bake 5-9x, images unchanged. Full 14-scene suite on the merge: grazing 67% diff (34k missed), sweeps-16/32/64 8-18% - scenes opened after another reuse the previous field. Reverted (f29651a); agent fixing with full-suite verification.
